title: Orphaned Ticket Status Rescued
changes: Added support for editing legacy/imported Site History entries while preserving the original imported source data.
Fixed Ticket Status renames so existing tickets automatically update to the new status name.
Fixed the Dispatch Tickets “All / Include Closed” status filter so it truly includes tickets with any status, including legacy or inactive statuses.
Added a copy-to-clipboard button beside Site numbers in Field Technician History, with the same temporary checkmark feedback used for Notifications and Work Orders.

title: Daily Assignment workflow and SNMP synchronization hotfix
changes: Changed Daily Assignments so publishing or removing technician and crew assignments no longer changes ticket workflow status.
Removed obsolete Assigned, In Progress, and Waiting Dispatch ticket-status workflow dependencies.
Fixed Daily Assignment removal so ticket assignment fields are cleared when no active assignment remains.
Improved write-up participant resolution so current crew members are included even when crew assignments change after Field Technician is opened.
Updated SNMP target IP synchronization so manually edited Network View IP addresses are used by the matching SNMP target after Test or Refresh SNMP Config.

title: DACS network and SAP reconciliation fixes
changes: Changed DACS RTU IP to a reference-only field because the RTU address is not directly pingable.
Removed DACS RTU from Ping All, Test All, and ping-stat testing.
Fixed SAP Queue Import status controls displaying stale values after scrolling.
Hidden New Status controls when no dispatcher status selection is required.
Moved SAP reconciliation rows requiring review or action to the top of the Import Preview.

title: Dispatch filtering, SAP review, and scrolling improvements
changes: Updated Dispatch Tickets summary cards to reflect active date, technician, search, and quick filters.
Changed Dispatch Tickets default ordering to newest Created Date first.
Improved SAP Queue reconciliation to prevent blank ticket statuses and surface affected tickets as Needs Review.
Improved SAP Queue Import Preview horizontal scrolling and shortened reconciliation messages.
Added vertical scrolling to Truck Assignments while preserving the existing 3-by-3 truck card sizing.
Improved mouse-wheel scrolling over truck cards and assigned technician cards.
Improved Field Technician task details scrolling for long Dispatch Notes and Site Notes.
Added the associated TOP Radio A IP address to Site Dashboard write-up ping statistics.

title: Multi-crew assignments and SAP reconciliation
changes: Added support for assigning the same Daily Assignment ticket to multiple crews or technicians while preserving independent route ownership.
Added Add Crew versus Move Here behavior when assigning a ticket that is already on another route.
Improved multi-crew write-up handling so each crew can complete its own field work while participating technicians retain the appropriate Site History records.
Updated Dispatch Tasks to combine multiple submitted write-ups, write-up flags, Refer To selections, and closeout requirements for the same ticket.
Collapsed duplicate Dispatch closeout requirements across multiple write-ups into a single logical checklist item while preserving ticket-wide completion enforcement.
Fixed Daily Assignment removal and Clear List behavior so removing a shared ticket from one route does not remove it from another crew's route.
Improved Daily Assignment drag-and-drop behavior so the Add Crew or Move Here prompt no longer leaves a suspended ticket visual behind the dialog.
Added SAP Import Queue reconciliation for existing SmartGridSuite tickets, including review of tickets missing from the SAP import and controlled status changes.

title: Daily Assignments workflow and Field Technician stability
changes: Redesigned Dispatch Daily Assignments with selectable technician and crew cards, stable alphabetical ordering, assignment status indicators, and a more compact route-focused layout.
Improved the Daily Assignments Ticket Pool and Work List with compact ticket cards, clearer selected-target information, and easier route management.
Added double-click ticket editing from both the Daily Assignments Ticket Pool and assigned Work List.
Added New Ticket directly to Daily Assignments so Dispatch can create work without leaving the assignment pane.
Fixed a Field Technician Site Dashboard issue where opening another ticket from Tasks could copy an existing write-up into a Blank tab and crash the application after cancelling the warning.
Fixed the Administration Dispatch Closeout Checklist Trigger selector so saved Write-Up Flag and Refer To triggers display their friendly names instead of contract type names.

title: Field workflow synchronization and Site Dashboard reliability
changes: Improved Site Dashboard ticket resolution so write-ups and ticket actions stay tied to the correct ticket when multiple active tickets exist for the same site.
Added API-side protection against submitting a write-up to a ticket that does not belong to the currently loaded site.
Improved Refer To handling so selections appear in the Submit Write-Up preview and are preserved in the permanent submitted write-up.
Fixed a Field Technician crash that could occur when returning Home with an unsaved Site Dashboard write-up.
Improved SNMP Poll All so each Site Dashboard tab keeps its own polling state and results cannot appear on the wrong site tab.
Added per-tab Stop support for SNMP Poll All and improved running-state feedback.
Improved selected Site Dashboard tab visibility across application themes.
Added Daily Assignment lifecycle tracking so submitting a write-up completes the current Daily Assignment without removing the technician from the ticket.
Improved Field Technician task synchronization so completed Daily Assignments disappear automatically and active assigned tickets can move to Other Assigned Tickets.
Preserved completed work in technician History independently of the current Daily Assignment.
Allowed a completed ticket assignment to be dispatched again later as a new Daily Assignment without restoring the previous completed assignment.
Preserved Daily Assignment publication snapshots for audit history and future publish-change tracking.
Improved Dispatch Tickets Open Details button sizing.

title: Field testing reliability and workflow improvements
changes: Added clear failure and retry handling for Site Dashboard Ticket, Maintenance, and Capital requests when connectivity is interrupted.
Added retry protection so uncertain Maintenance and Capital requests do not create duplicate Dispatch Notes.
Added protection against losing unsubmitted Site Dashboard write-up text when closing a site tab, loading another site into the same tab, returning Home, or closing the Field Technician module.
Preserved Site Dashboard write-up text while technicians move between Site Dashboard, Tasks, and History.
Fixed Site History matching so DACS and corresponding MR sites remain separate, including sites such as 6849 and 6849MR.
Improved Dispatch Ticket controls, including Edit Ticket styling, action ordering, and staged Status filtering.
Improved technician assignment selection and ticket editing workflows.
Improved Dispatch Tasks presentation for write-up changes, equipment replacements, and IP-address changes.
Made the Site Dashboard write-up submit area more compact for laptop-height displays.

title: Write-up laptop and Tower search hotfix
changes: Fixed the Site Dashboard write-up panel on laptop-height displays so expanded Write-Up Flags, Refer To options, and SNMP categories cannot hide the Submit button.
Made the write-up options independently scrollable while keeping the Submit button pinned and visible.
Fixed Tower searches so hyphens, underscores, and spaces are treated equivalently.
Fixed Tower search fallback so cached tower data is searched when the Parent database returns no matching live results.

title: Write-up workflow and Dispatch closeout overhaul
changes: Added configurable technician Write-Up Flags, including protected DB Correction Needed and Will Need Follow-Up system flags.
Added configurable Refer To destinations with support for selecting multiple departments or work groups on a write-up.
Added automatic API-side DB Correction Needed detection when equipment is replaced or an existing site IP address is changed.
Added configurable Dispatch closeout checklist definitions with Always, Write-Up Flag, and Refer To selection triggers.
Added persistent shared Dispatch closeout checklists that record completion status, completed by, and completed date/time.
Added API-enforced ticket closure rules so required closeout items must be completed before a ticket can be closed.
Redesigned Dispatch Tasks with expandable rows containing the submitted technician write-up, selected flags, Refer To destinations, and shared closeout checklist.
Added activity-aware automatic refreshing to Dispatch Tasks without interrupting active dispatcher work.
Expanded RX searching and improved cached fallback behavior when the Parent database is unavailable.
Improved Tower search and Tower dashboard cached fallback behavior.
Improved application title-bar and network-result theming across supported themes.

title: Reliability and performance improvements
changes: Added Site Dashboard parent-database timeout handling with automatic cached-data fallback.
Updated RX reverse-IP lookup to return all matching sites and prioritize MR sites.
Fixed the Dispatch Tickets details Edit button and disabled Bulk Set controls while details are open.
Replaced the Ready to Assign quick filter with Missing WO Type.
Fixed active-theme styling in the Add/Edit Site Notes window.
Improved submitted write-up formatting and technician-name resolution.
Released WebView2 browser resources when the Dispatcher closes.
Improved Dispatcher navigation performance by reusing pane instances.

title: Site Dashboard and Field History refinements
changes: Improved Site Dashboard network presentation and theme readability.
Improved equipment replacement entry sizing and validation while keeping serial numbers optional.
Cleaned up submitted write-up formatting, including Ping Stats, equipment replacements, and VSWR ratios.
Improved the New Ticket Assigned To dropdown across application themes.
Added smooth scrolling for long submitted write-ups in Field Technician History.

title: Write-up and request dialog fixes
changes: Improved the Request Ticket, Request Capital, and Request Maintenance dialog layout.
Added all assigned technicians to the submitted write-up technician footer.
Ensured completed work appears in each participating technician's History.
Added all participating technicians as write-up email recipients.

title: Site History Edit/Delete Button
changes: Found left over Edit and Delete buttons on Site History. Removed them.

title: Local SNMP polling fix
changes: Changed SNMP GET and SET operations to run directly from the client laptop instead of the API server.
Kept SNMP profiles, credentials, OIDs, formulas, and decode mappings centrally managed by the API.
Restored SNMP polling for cached dashboards when the API server cannot directly reach field radio networks.
Fixed SNMP profile selection so the current profile is preserved and matched to the site's communication type.
Verified single OID polling, Poll All, and SNMP SET operations from cached site dashboards.

title: Parent database resilience and complete offline fallback
changes: Added complete last-known Parent database caching for AMS/MR, DACS, IGSD, Range Extender, tower, and tower-sector data.
Added automatic live-to-cache fallback when the Parent database is unavailable.
Added Limited Mode when the Parent database is unavailable and no cached site data exists.
Added cached tower searching and complete cached tower dashboards.
Added a transactional cache refresh process that preserves the previous cache if a refresh fails.
Added an automatic weekly cache refresh scheduled for Sunday at 2:00 AM.
Kept ping diagnostics, SNMP tools, tickets, notes, Site History, and write-up submission available during Parent database outages.
Added the correct AMS/MR, IG, DACS, and Range Extender layouts in Limited Mode.
Restored the Portal tab for IG and DACS dashboards in Limited Mode.
Moved Site Dashboard status messages above the Pop-Out button.
Improved cached-data status messages and timestamps.
Changed the default Interface Size setting to 100%.

title: Display scaling improvements
changes: Added automatic interface scaling for docked external monitors.
Added an Interface Size selector with automatic and manual sizing options.
Kept the Module Launcher, About App, and Bug / Feature Request windows at their original sizes.
Improved Smart Grid Suite readability on monitors configured at 100% Windows scaling.

title: Update Corruption
changes: Removed Duplicate App Manifest asInvoker privileges.

title: Update Corruption
changes: Packaged and uploaded new version due to 1.0.0.6 update file corruption.

title: Windows DPI Aware, sizing issues.
changes: Allows WPF to react when window moves between monitors w/ different DPI settings.
Corrected sizing Dispatch->Technician Truck cards. Optimized for laptop screens.

title: Text Correction, Admin-> Tech-> Add Tech
changes: Correct Text color on Dispatch->Tickets Details and Dispatch->Tasks Details
Corrected Admin->Tech-> Add Tech Window to be themed. Changed Border Color.
Corrected DataGrid in Admin->SNMP->Add OID to be themed.

title: Tickets & Themes
changes: Finished up the colors on themes. You're welcome David
Corrected Theme Controls
Got rid of the 'Design Test' in the admin window.
Flip-flopped CNP Logo Image depending on Theme (white font, black font).
Ensured application opens Landing Page after each module is closed and ensured app shuts down after exiting Landing Page.
Updated Dispatch -> Tickets Search Debounce from 250ms to 650ms.
Added Loading Overlay when searching Tickets.
Added option to delete ticket while holding onto Site History associated (API, Contracts & Client).
Corrected first Daily Assignment Email doesn't say 'Modified'. Every email after that in the same calendar day says 'Modified'.

title: Client -> API Connection Updates
changes: Corrected Https:// to http:// in ClientAppSettings.

title: Deployment and version management
changes: Added automatic ClickOnce update support.
Added installed, latest, and minimum-supported version checking.
The launcher now expands when a connectivity warning is displayed.
Smart Grid Suite can now be installed and updated from the central server.

title: Launcher and support-window cleanup
changes: About and Bug / Feature Request were moved into dedicated XAML windows.
About was redesigned with company branding and a more compact layout.
Change Log was moved into its own dedicated window.
Bug / Feature Request now generates a structured clipboard template.

title: Dispatch, General Settings, and Site Dashboard updates
changes: Communication Device Types can now be added, edited, deleted, and managed from General Settings.
Dispatch can copy selected Work Orders as a vertical list for Excel and time entry.
Work Order length protection was added across the UI, API, and database.
Dispatch can edit technician write-ups from the task details pane.
Site Dashboard write-up typing performance was improved.
